name: The land remembers
text: The land does not belong to those who stay. It remembers those who pass.
sources: the owner's draft of nomadic-migration sayings for the cutscenes, 2026-10-01
notes: Carried by the glass herbalists since 2 October 2026: the owner asked for the fictional sayings to belong to the lore's various peoples, not all to the Vedda.
